title: Adjust the Thinking Budget

body.text: Extended Thinking is adjustable — how much
time Claude spends thinking before answering
— more for hard tasks, quick answers for easy ones. In the API it's set as budget_tokens; in the app you pick a level.

example: "A 10-year financial planning problem → high thinking / 'what day is it today' → no thinking, instant answer"

title: Balance quality and speed

body.text: more accurate but slower and more expensive
— start low, and only increase if the answer isn't good enough, rather than maxing it out every time and wasting it.

example: "Summarizing an email: low thinking is enough / reviewing a legal contract: increase thinking for careful reasoning"
